Play what people there actually heard back then, in the original recordings, all released by 1991: mostly songs by artists from there, in their own language (that year's biggest hits on the radio, on TV, on YouTube and in the streaming charts, the dance and party favourites, and the regional and street sounds everyone was playing), plus only the foreign hits that were genuinely big there at the time. Keep it at least two-thirds local. Start with the songs below, which were the hits there that year. They are only where the trip begins: play as many of them as feel right, then keep going and fill my whole stay with everything else that belongs there. Take me on as long a trip as you can, and don't bring me home early. Order everything so each song flows into the next and nothing jars.
